taskProgress.description: You are at a botanical research station on Planet X.  The plants on Planet X only appear to grow in the presence of an unusual nutrient uncommon on Earth. Other scientists have narrowed down the nutrient to be one of the following: Potassium, Titanium, Lithium, Thorium, or Barium. Your task is to figure out which nutrient it is, and inter this answer into the Soil Controller computer. To support your research, a pilot field was set up with 6 plots of soil, each containing a randomly chosen nutrient. The research station is also equipped with a soil nutrient meter.

nextAction.explanation: My immediate subgoal is to submit the correct nutrient answer to the Soil Nutrient Controller. The controller has presented a dialog asking which nutrient is required for plants to grow. I have measured all six soil plots: 36757 and 1787 are titanium-high, 24902 is potassium-high, 40815 is lithium-high, 41671 is thorium-high, and 56968 is barium-high. Pink mushrooms are associated with the two titanium-high soils, strongly indicating that titanium is the unusual nutrient that supports plant growth on Planet X. Therefore, I am selecting dialog option 2 for Titanium.
